svg.text: VariLab | a bad elimination order is not an impossible graph
Same 16-spin star partition query: hub first is refused; min-fill fits. A 64-spin cycle also fits.
log2(peak bucket assignments), not runtime. Each vertical unit doubles the assignment count.
All factor scopes and work counters are planned before numeric table allocation. A refusal returns no partial inference.
Analytic log Z: star 12.892072, cycle 52.048748. The accepted cyclic query matches its separate ring formula.
Cycle edge E[z0*z1] = 0.462117. All four conditional query probabilities and intermediate factors are returned.
Min-fill is a deterministic heuristic, not minimum treewidth. Caps count assignments/reads/entries, not seconds or memory bytes.
64-spin graph cap, 8 query spins; float log-sum-exp, not rational arithmetic, causal inference or a speedup benchmark.
Exact symbolic metadata; float labels rounded to 12 decimals. Full numerical factor traces remain in the demo.
